opportunities.name: Source a candidate from GitHub and their blog, then email the hiring manager
opportunities.description: In the GitHub tab, click the search box, type {username}, and open the user profile {username} -> Note the follower count and the most-starred pinned repository; open it and note its stars and main language -> Open a new tab, go to {blog} and note the title of the most recent post, then close the tab -> Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type hiring@example.com, click Subject and type "Lead for {role}: {username}" -> Click Body and type "{username}: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <title>." Do not click Send. Click Discard
steps: In the GitHub tab, click the search box, type {username}, and open the user profile {username}
Note the follower count and the most-starred pinned repository; open it and note its stars and main language
Open a new tab, go to {blog} and note the title of the most recent post, then close the tab
Switch to the Mail tab, click To and type hiring@example.com, click Subject and type "Lead for {role}: {username}"
Click Body and type "{username}: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <title>." Do not click Send. Click Discard

opportunities.name: Fact-check a person on Wikipedia and an old page on the Wayback Machine
opportunities.description: In the Wikipedia tab, search "{person}" and open the article; note the birth date and current or last position -> Switch to the Wayback Machine tab, type {site} in the search box and press Enter -> Pick the year {year} in the timeline, click a highlighted day in the calendar and open the snapshot -> Note the page title and one headline on the snapshot, then click Back to return to the Wayback Machine home -> Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{person}: born <date>, <position>. {site} in {year}: <headline>" and press Enter
steps: In the Wikipedia tab, search "{person}" and open the article; note the birth date and current or last position
Switch to the Wayback Machine tab, type {site} in the search box and press Enter
Pick the year {year} in the timeline, click a highlighted day in the calendar and open the snapshot
Note the page title and one headline on the snapshot, then click Back to return to the Wayback Machine home
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "{person}: born <date>, <position>. {site} in {year}: <headline>" and press Enter
